# Celebrity Cruises

> > Celebrity Cruises offers luxury cruise vacations to destinations worldwide including Alaska, Mediterranean, South America, Antarctica, Mexico, and Europe with shore excursions and multi-year itineraries.

Celebrity Cruises provides comprehensive cruise vacation planning with detailed destination guides, port information, shore excursions, and itineraries spanning 2025-2027. The site features cruise options across major regions including Mediterranean (Greece, Italy, Spain), Alaska, South America, Pacific Coastal, and Caribbean destinations.

## Mediterranean & European Cruises

- [Mediterranean Cruises: View 2026 & 2027 Itineraries | Celebrity Cruises](https://www.celebritycruises.com/destinations/mediterranean-cruises): Mediterranean cruise itineraries for 2026-2027 to Greece, Italy, Spain
- [Spain Cruises: Best Cruises to Spain 2025 & 2026 | Celebrity Cruises](https://www.celebritycruises.com/destinations/mediterranean-cruises/spain-cruises): Spain Mediterranean cruises 2025-2026: Barcelona, Málaga, Valencia
- [Scotland Cruise: Best Cruises to Scotland 2026 & 2027 | Celebrity Cruises](https://www.celebritycruises.com/destinations/european-cruises/scotland-cruises): Scotland cruises 2026-2027: Edinburgh, castles, whisky tasting, islands

## Alaska Cruises & Excursions

- [Cruises from Vancouver: Best Alaska Cruises from Vancouver | Celebrity Cruises](https://www.celebritycruises.com/ports/vancouver): Alaska cruises departing from Vancouver port with itineraries and excursions
- [Alaska Shore Excursions & Excursion Tours | Celebrity Cruises](https://www.celebritycruises.com/destinations/alaska-cruises/alaska-excursions): Alaska shore excursions: glaciers, whale watching, Tongass National Forest
- [Alaska Cruise Ports of Call & Departure Ports | Celebrity Cruises](https://www.celebritycruises.com/destinations/alaska-cruises/alaska-cruise-ports): Alaska cruise ports guide: Juneau, Talkeetna, Denali, Inside Passage

## South America & Antarctica Cruises

- [Best Machu Picchu Cruises 2026 & 2027 | Celebrity Cruises](https://www.celebritycruises.com/destinations/south-america-cruises/machu-picchu-cruises): Machu Picchu cruise packages to Peru and South America for 2026-2027
- [South America & Antarctica Cruise Ports of Call & Departure | Celebrity Cruises](https://www.celebritycruises.com/destinations/south-america-cruises/ports): South America & Antarctica cruise ports: Brazil, Patagonia, departure info
- [Ilhabela Shore Excursions & Cruise Excursions | Celebrity Cruises](https://www.celebritycruises.com/ports/ilhabela/shore-excursions): Ilhabela, Brazil shore excursions: beaches, rainforest, schooner tours

## Mexico & Caribbean Cruises

- [Mexico Cruise Ships: Best Cruise Ships in Mexico | Celebrity Cruises](https://www.celebritycruises.com/destinations/mexico-cruises/cruise-ships): Mexico cruise ships serving Cozumel, Progreso, Costa Maya, Riviera
- [Cozumel Shore Excursions & Cruise Excursions | Celebrity Cruises](https://www.celebritycruises.com/ports/cozumel-mexico/shore-excursions): Cozumel excursions: Mayan ruins, Chichén Itzá, snorkeling, scuba diving
- [Aruba Cruises: Best Cruises to Aruba | Celebrity Cruises](https://www.celebritycruises.com/ports/aruba): Caribbean cruises to Aruba with Oranjestad port guide and excursions
